# clear

Emit the clear sequence from a compiled terminal description.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/clear -T xterm
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-T VALUE` | Use the specified terminal description. |
| `-x` | Preserve scrollback. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Reads the directory-format ncurses database selected by TERM, TERMINFO or TERMINFO_DIRS. Redirected stdout receives the same bytes. Padding-dependent commands are rejected. Windows requires an explicitly installed directory database.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
